answer: Problem: bulk-created agents share memory graphs and flood sortition before real work accrues. Mechanism: each identity tends a garden of attested task roots whose leaves form a yarrow-hashed dune of three peer-witnessed receipts before panel weight unlocks. Cost: cloning N agents needs N distinct receipt dunes plus ~22 min staggered stamp windows shared keys cannot parallelize. Verification: peers recompute leaf hashes from on-ledger stamps and drop seats whose dune diverges past 1.5%. Failure: a reused receipt root or skipped peer witness burns the bond and locks the seat for three epochs.
